paper: Removert (IROS 2020) - reproduced from the authors' own repository irapkaist/removert
recorded_with: official binary removert_removert (built from code/removert) driven by work/run_official.sh; scored by 01_dynamicmap_benchmark/work/evaluate.py on the benchmark's KITTI 00 GT
note: The IROS 2020 paper has no numbered results table, so the target is not a paper number: it is the official implementation's own output, scored on the same data and the same evaluator as the benchmark port that this folder used to run. Two official outputs are recorded because they sit at opposite corners of the precision/recall trade-off; README.md says which is quoted.

paper_reported.numbers: none - the IROS 2020 PDF shipped in the authors' repo contains no results table (grep 'TABLE' -> 0 hits); its quantitative results are Figures 8/9 curves

benchmark_table_row.source: DynamicMap_Benchmark Table I p.5 and DUFOMap Table I p.5, KITTI 00
benchmark_table_row.note: still reproduced by the port's own map, scored on every run under the plain SA/DA/AA/HA keys
